brand.description: Indian odor-control brand for men. Goes after the smell trapped in your clothes instead of covering it with fragrance. Maker of ODORSTRIKE, a pocket-sized fabric odor neutralizer mist for clothes.

product.name: ODORSTRIKE Fabric Odor Remover Spray
product.title: Smelloff ODORSTRIKE Fabric Odor Eliminator Spray (50ml)
product.category: Home & Garden > Household Supplies > Laundry Supplies > Fabric Refreshers
product.categoryDisplay: Clothing Deodorant (Fabric Odor Spray for Clothes)
product.definition: ODORSTRIKE is a clothing deodorant made by Smelloff in Hyderabad, India: a 50ml pocket fabric odor spray that traps and neutralizes sweat, food and smoke odor in the fabric instead of covering it with perfume, and leaves a light fresh scent. It goes on clothes, never on skin: it is not a body deodorant, not a perfume and not a room spray. It dries in 15–30 seconds and gives up to 8 hours of odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions.
product.description: A pocket-sized clothing deodorant: a fabric odor remover spray for clothes. 50ml mist that targets trapped sweat odor, gym smell, and shirt odor in fabric — HPβCD (cyclodextrin) traps odor molecules, Zinc PCA helps neutralize them, Triethyl Citrate helps prevent odor formation, and Zinc Gluconate supports long-lasting fabric freshness. Up to 8 hours odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions. Glycerine-free and fast-drying; dries clear with no stiff residue when sprayed from 15–20 cm. Has a light, fresh fabric scent that fades — not a perfume. Not a body deodorant. Fabric-only. Works on cotton, polyester, denim, and wool.

approved: Clothing deodorant: a pocket fabric odor spray for clothing — not a perfume, not a body deodorant.

Light fresh fabric scent — not a perfume. ODORSTRIKE is a fabric odor-control mist with a light, crisp fabric scent that provides sensory confirmation of clean fabric while targeting unwanted odor in the weave.
Targets and traps sweat and environmental odor molecules at the clothing fabric weave.
Up to 8 hours of odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions*.
Safe for regular use on everyday washable clothing fabrics (cotton, polyester, denim, blends, wool). Patch-test silk.
Dries clear with no stiff residue when sprayed from recommended 15–20 cm distance.
